name: duckling_crest_puff_mk2
rationale: Revision after round-0 needs-review (recipe 47de1147…): renders show the crest is host-eligible but reads as a tiny yellow speck far from the head apex. Fix: enlarge the puff cluster and broaden the base for presence. Base grows 14x12x2.5 -> 18x16x3; center puff grows to 16x13x11 at [0,0,5.5] tilted back -15deg (lowest Z ~5.5-5.4~0.1, inside base thickness with full XY overlap). Two side puffs (bilateral, Y=+4 only, host mirrors) at [-2.5,4,6] sized 10x6x7 tilted back -25deg keep lowest Z ~1.8mm>0 and overlap the base in XY. Total silhouette roughly doubles in apparent area while staying soft, rounded ellipsoids with no sharp edges; mass stays far under 16 g and the 18x16 footprint plus ~11 mm height sits well inside the 80x80x35 mm zone. Part stays rear-of-apex on the head-top slope, clear of the front camera lens and dome seen in the +X and perspective views. Adhesive-pad attachment, curvature fit, printability and walking remain open per the brief.
